components.heading: Pile drivers, hammers and derricks.
components.text: The operation between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. of any pile driver, steam shovel, pneumatic hammer, derrick, steam or electric hoist or other appliance, the use of which is attended by loud or unusual noise, is unlawful. (Code 1981 § 27-16. Code 1995 § 54-162.)
